title: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
plot_overview: An atheist skeptic is drawn into a mysterious journey connected to an ancient temple. As he investigates secrets surrounding the sacred site, he encounters forces beyond his understanding and is challenged to rethink his beliefs about faith, destiny, and the supernatural.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like supernatural mysteries involving ancient temples, faith, and skeptical investigators; Not for you if you need a consistently focused story or dislike distracting comedic detours.
review_summary: Pros: intriguing temple mystery; strong early setup; eerie atmosphere | Cons: uneven story; distracting comedy; flat detours
